input.quote: Customer may terminate an Order Form immediately if Vendor suffers a material Security Incident, repeatedly misses a critical service level, violates Applicable Law in performing the Services, or infringes a third party's intellectual property and cannot provide the remedies required by Section 20.5.
input.rationale: The Agreement has no indemnification section at all — Sections 9.3, 19.4, 21.3 and 30.5 all assume indemnities exist (including a cross-reference to a non-existent Section 20.5), but no Vendor defence or indemnity obligation is granted anywhere. That is walk-away territory, so we have inserted a Vendor indemnity for third-party IP claims, breach of Applicable Law, Vendor-caused data breach and gross negligence/wilful misconduct, with standard procedure and IP remedies; it sits outside the cap via the existing Excluded Claims definition.
